'''R3-Y2''' was an [[R3-series astromech droid]] that served in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War]]. It was stationed in the command center of [[Echo Base]], the Alliance's headquarters on the [[planet]] [[Hoth]]. After the base was discovered by the [[Galactic Empire]], R3-Y2 helped to evacuate the rebel forces stationed there during the [[Battle of Hoth]].

==Biography==
During the [[Galactic Civil War]], R3-Y2 served in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and was stationed in the command center of [[Echo Base]],<ref name="IncrediBuilds" /> the Alliance's secret headquarters on the [[planet]] [[Hoth]]. Shortly before the [[Battle of Hoth]]<ref name="ESB" /> in [[3 ABY]],<ref name="Galactic Atlas">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas: Updated Edition]]''</ref> R3-Y2 stood by one of the command center's display panels when [[Captain]] [[Han Solo]] entered the room and passed by the [[droid]] while searching for [[General]] [[Carlist Rieekan]].<ref name="ESB" />

The droid later stood by<ref name="ESB" /> the base's senior [[controller]], [[Wyron Serper]],<ref name="Junior Novel">[[Star Wars: The Empire Strikes Back (paperback novel)|''Star Wars: The Empire Strikes Back'' junior novelization]]</ref> when he reported to Solo and Rieekan on signals coming from the [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]]<ref name="ESB" /> [[Viper probe droid]] [[XJ9-CS14]],<ref name="Droidography">''[[Star Wars: Droidography]]''</ref> which had landed nearby. The [[probe droid]]'s discovery of the rebels on Hoth led to the Empire attacking Echo Base.<ref name="ESB" /> During the ensuing battle, R3-Y2 helped to evacuate the base's personnel,<ref name="IncrediBuilds" /> most of whom successfully escaped the base before it was captured by the Empire.<ref name="HC9">{{HelmetCollectionCite|9|Highlights of the Saga}}</ref>

==Characteristics==
R3-Y2 was an [[R3-series astromech droid]]<ref name="Stats" /> that was manufactured by [[Industrial Automaton]]<ref name="IncrediBuilds" /> and stood 1.09 [[meter]]s tall.<ref name="Stats" /> The [[R-series]] [[astromech droid]]<ref name="IncrediBuilds" /> had a transparent dome with [[Color|gold]] panels and a white chassis.<ref name="ESB" />

==Behind the scenes==
R3-Y2 first appeared in the [[1980]] [[original trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|''Star Wars'': Episode V ''The Empire Strikes Back'']].<ref name="ESB" /> The command center scenes featuring R3-Y2 were filmed on Stage 1 at [[Elstree Studios]] between [[March 22]] and [[March 28|28]], [[1979]].<ref name="MakingOf">''[[The Making of The Empire Strikes Back]]''</ref> In the new ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]], the droid was first identified by name in the ''[[Star Wars: R2-D2 Deluxe Book and Model Set]]'', which was written by [[Michael Kogge]] and released in [[2016]].<ref name="IncrediBuilds" /> The [[R3-Y2/Legends|droid's]] designation originated in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, where it was first given in the [[2006]] "Astromech Droid Pack Series II" action figure set released by [[Hasbro]] as part of ''[[Star Wars: The Saga Collection]]''.<ref name="Saga">{{HasbroCite|set=Star Wars: The Saga Collection|pack=Astromech Droid Pack (Series 2)|altlink=https://www.rebelscum.com/TSCastroS2.asp}}</ref>
